strengths.mechanism: Reader-facing Character Bio is separate from Personality, Scenario and Initial Message; tags support discovery.
strengths.benefitInference: Could explain the premise before chat without consuming model context with reader-facing promotional text; not interaction-tested.

strengths.mechanism: Lorebook forms progress to per-entry Advanced scripts, with Test Chat and a Changes debug panel.
strengths.benefitInference: Could let beginners add conditional lore and let experts diagnose activation without making every entry require code; not tested.

strengths.mechanism: Memory guide separates environment, relationship, current plot, character facts, user facts and consequential past events; documents recap prompts.
strengths.benefitInference: Could help writers preserve story decisions with less repeated scene text; no recall or automatic summarization claim.

strengths.mechanism: janitor+ Router documents model selection with context limits, token rates, generation settings and a wallet, without external API-key setup.
strengths.benefitInference: Could reduce connection setup mistakes and support informed model selection; no current catalog or price verification.

tradeoffs: Router documentation requires janitor+ and per-token billing; Router is documented as web only, with mobile support planned.
Mobile moderation requires changing Enable NSFW for App on the web to synchronize broader content access; approved-link restrictions are also described.
The mobile FAQ's blanket website-parity wording conflicts with Router's web-only documentation. Current app parity was not established.
Memory consumes limited context and needs concise curation; the guide's approximate JLLM context figure is not a universal current limit.
Script Changes debugging does not establish visibility into the complete assembled prompt.
Missing Chats warns that some server-migration losses cannot be restored. This is documentary evidence, not an observed loss or failure-rate estimate.
The Scripts walkthrough changes terminology for group selection; exact selection semantics were not tested.

characterOnboarding.note: Creation fields, reader-facing bio, initial premise and search/filter tags are documented. Actual selection flow and character import were not tested or established.

storyOrganization.note: Scripts walkthrough explicitly mentions + New Chat. Exact-story history, archive, naming, retrieval and continuation remain unknown.

editRetryBranch.note: Selected primary sources do not establish message editing, retry or branching workflows. This does not mean they are absent.

memoryLore.note: Structured chat memory guidance, recap prompting, keyword lorebook entries and advanced scripts. No automatic-summary or recall reliability verification.

promptTransparency.note: Scripts Test Chat exposes Show Debug Panel and Changes. Complete assembled-request inspection and prompt ordering remain unknown.

modelConnections.note: janitor+ Router connects third-party models without external API keys and retains external proxies as an option. Router is subscriber-only and web-only in the inspected guide; current catalog unknown.

advancedControls.note: Custom prompts and generation settings are documented for Router; lorebook conditions and per-entry Advanced scripts are documented. Exact sampler coverage unknown.

groupRoleplay.note: Lorebook inclusion groups do not establish multi-character group chat orchestration.

imagesVoice.note: Character image upload and custom-CSS images do not establish native image generation, voices or dictation.

mobile.note: Official help describes iOS and Android apps and content settings synchronized through the web. No device test; Router remains web-only in its guide, so blanket parity is unsupported.

portability.note: Scripts walkthrough documents copying the entries array into JSON Editor. This limited inbound lorebook path does not establish character/chat migration, native export or backup restoration; not tested.

selfHosting.note: No self-hosting instructions or verified official application source distribution established. External model routing is not evidence of self-hosting the product.
